propositions: review_interrupts metric is published dimensionless and conflates two distinct causes (bound-exceeded vs signal-unavailable) that require opposite remediations
CloudWatch alarms cannot distinguish bound-exceeded (bot busy, drain working) from signal-unavailable (probe broken, deploys blind) without shell access to host journal
observability.sh must emit two separate metrics from journal patterns matching bound-exceeded and signal-unavailable reasons in AUTODEPLOY_REVIEW_INTERRUPT markers
monitoring_autodeploy.tf must replace the single review_interrupts alarm with two reason-scoped alarms, each carrying only its own remediation
rolled-up review_interrupts metric must remain published to preserve pre-split history and count any future reasons, but must not trigger an alarm to avoid double-paging
terraform apply in infra/terraform is required to activate the new alarms and remove the old single alarm
